negative_bkms.title: DOM Edge Regex Sanitization Anti-Pattern on Streaming Binary Protocols
negative_bkms.anti_pattern_description: Attempting to apply DOM character-boundary regex parsing and string transformation to high-throughput continuous binary streams.
negative_bkms.failure_mode: 400% latency bloat, CPU core saturation, frame dropping, and thread starvation.
negative_bkms.correct_alternative_pattern: Zero-copy binary framing, protocol buffer schema validation, and dedicated background worker decoding.
negative_bkms.governance_rule: Enforce strict DO_NOT_TRANSFER when BKM-CANARY-001 is proposed for binary streaming architectures.
